summary: Selected only Proposal 1, the full-matrix rank obstruction and fixed-witness lift-or-kill audit, because both opponent reviews reject every architecture-changing alternative and require this discriminator first. The compiled universal Lean theorem proves its sharp algebraic kernel: if three integrally independent seam directions survive every emitted non-transfer integer row and their leading symbols lie in one F_17^2 transfer coordinate, then a nonzero integral combination also survives every such row, has zero leading transfer, has each coefficient in [-8,8], and has squared coefficient weight at most 192. This is not Q1 and does not assert that the campaign's three directions survive the missing full NAND/COPY rows or that the combination has CVP energy below 17E.

The causal mechanism is the dimension-three to dimension-two residue dependency, centered-lifted to a bounded integer combination; linearity then preserves every emitted row. The expected frontier move is to turn that certified combination into an exact full-tile low-energy witness. The candidate is falsified if the hash-locked full matrix admits an adverse extension below 17E; this particular discriminator is cleared, without proving Q1, if an SNF/left-kernel certificate shows no extension or exact minimization proves every extension reaches the threshold.
